verdict.rationale: Formant's on-robot agent (Docker install, Agent SDK) captures telemetry and sensor data and syncs it to the cloud via the ingestion/query APIs (formant-docs-1, formant-docs-2, formant-docs-3, formant-docs-27), and each data stream can be rate-limited to control bandwidth usage (formant-docs-31), directly supporting bandwidth-aware policies. missing for 10: explicit documentation of offline buffering/store-and-forward behavior during connectivity loss, and independent/hands-on validation of bandwidth policy effectiveness beyond vendor docs.
